conbody.p: Impact, under Verify in the project menu, traces what a change to one artifact would reach through its traceability links. Pick an artifact, or choose Show impact on an artifact or in the matrix, then a direction:

ul.li: Downstream (dependents): the artifacts that depend on this one, which a change here could affect.
Upstream (dependencies): the artifacts this one depends on, its sources and rationale.

conbody.p: The artifacts it reaches are grouped by type, each with the link type that reached it and how many hops away it is. Hover one to see the path of links that leads to it, and click it to open it in Requirements.
